items.title: Started in support
items.text: Thousands of calls taught me which rule sits behind a complaint

items.title: Led by data
items.text: I read the member dashboard weekly and A/B test rule changes

items.title: Gets things done
items.text: Led stores, finance, IT and marketing on the top-up redesign

notes: In one line: I've spent nine years beside our members, from taking their complaints to rewriting the rules that caused them. Three things describe me. I started in customer support, and thousands of calls taught me that members rarely complain about a server. They complain about a rule nobody explained. I lead with data: I read the member dashboard every week and test a change on a small group first. And I get things done across teams. The top-up card redesign needed four departments, and I led it.
